HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD ?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:AHC:180038 Court No. - 88 Case :- APPLICATION U/S 482 No. - 34473 of 2023 Applicant :- Hiralal Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Hon'ble Sanjay Kumar Singh,J.
1-Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned Additional Government Advocate for the State of U.P./opposite party no.1 and perused the record.

2-This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant to quash the summoning order dated 04.10.2018, Non-bailable warrant dated 23.09.2022 issued against the applicant by learned Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Court No.2, Kanpur Nagar as well as further proceeding of Complaint Case No. 68988 of 2017 (Smt. Sita Devi Vs. Hiralal), under Sections 420, 406, 504, 506 I.P.C., Police Station-Kalyanpur, District-Kanpur Nagar, pending in the Court of learned Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Court No.2, Kanpur Nagar.
Hiralal vs State Of U.P. And Another on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/171352281/
1

entities.text: Hiralal vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
3-At the outset learned counsel for the applicant gave up his challenge to the aforesaid summoning order, order of non-bailable warrant and further proceeding against the applicant by contending at the Bar that he is not pressing the prayer made in this application on merits and confined his submission requesting to grant some protection to the applicant to surrender before the concerned Court below.
4

- Learned A.G.A. for the State of U.P. submits that in case the applicant is not pressing the relief as sought for by him on merits and wants to surrender before the concerned court below, he has no objection if the Court grants protection to him for a short period.
5-In view of the above, the relief as sought by the applicant in the instant application is refused.

6-However considering the aforesaid alternative prayer made by learned counsel for the applicant, it is directed that the applicant shall surrender before the concerned Court below within two weeks from today and in case applies for bail, the bail application of the applicant shall be disposed of expeditiously by the Courts below in accordance with law and keeping in view the guidelines as laid down by the Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil vs Central Bureau of Investigation and another, reported in 2021 SCC Online SC 922.
7

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil vs Central Bureau of Investigation and another, reported in 2021 SCC Online SC 922
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: -For the period of two weeks from today or till the time of surrender of the applicant before the concerned Court below, whichever is earlier, non-bailable warrant dated 23.09.2022 shall be kept in abeyance.
8-With the above observations and directions, this application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is disposed of.

Order Date :- 18.9.2023 Kashifa  Hiralal vs State Of U.P. And Another on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/171352281/
